decision.summary: Two candidate temporary offsets identified within allowed context [365,579]: (1) a prolonged N/E/U divergent trend (400–529) featuring a partial reversal at 525–529 without confirmed return; (2) a short U spike with correlated N/E dips (525–530) lacking a clear opposing recovery. Neither interval satisfies full onset–interior–return criteria on all affected axes; status remains uncertain due to incomplete or ambiguous returns.

Onset (gradual) and interior (sustained) are clear, but return is incomplete/ambiguous within allowed context.

U component shows a sharp transient spike peaking at ~526, followed by rapid drop ending at 530; N and E show correlated multi-sample dips (525–530) but no matching permanent offset. The U spike is isolated in shape and duration (~5 samples), with no clear opposing return before 531. Interior is transient, not sustained; onset and return both abrupt but unpaired across axes.
